function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, whether it was successful or not

function.name: IWICStreamImpl_Revert
function.description: This function reverts the changes made to the stream object, if any.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of a stream object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns WINCODEC_ERR_NOTINITIALIZED if the stream is not initialized, otherwise it returns the result of IStream_Revert function.

function.name: IWICStreamImpl_LockRegion
function.description: This function locks a specified region in the stream, restricting access to the region.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICStream interface

parameters.name: libOffset
parameters.description: The byte offset for the beginning of the lock region

parameters.name: cb
parameters.description: The length of the region, in bytes, to lock

parameters.name: dwLockType
parameters.description: The type of lock to place on the region

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the method succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: IWICStreamImpl_UnlockRegion
function.description: This function unlocks a region in the stream that was previously locked.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface that represents the stream to unlock.

parameters.name: libOffset
parameters.description: Specifies the byte offset for the beginning of the unlock region.

parameters.name: cb
parameters.description: Specifies, in bytes, the length of the unlock region.

parameters.name: dwLockType
parameters.description: Specifies the restrictions to place on others when they attempt to access the unlock region.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns WINCODEC_ERR_NOTINITIALIZED if the stream is not initialized, otherwise it returns the result of IStream_UnlockRegion function.

function.name: IWICStreamImpl_Stat
function.description: This function retrieves the STATSTG structure for this stream object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICStream interface

parameters.name: pstatstg
parameters.description: Pointer to a STATSTG structure where this method places information about this stream object

parameters.name: grfStatFlag
parameters.description: Specifies that this method does not return some of the members in the STATSTG structure, thus saving a memory allocation operation

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, the return value is S_OK. Otherwise, it is an error code.

function.name: IWICStreamImpl_Clone
function.description: This function clones an IWICStream interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICStream interface that is to be cloned.

parameters.name: ppstm
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IStream interface where the cloned stream is returned.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK. If the stream is not initialized, it returns WINCODEC_ERR_NOTINITIALIZED.

function.name: IWICStreamImpl_InitializeFromIStream
function.description: This function initializes a stream from an existing IStream interface. It also handles thread safety by using InterlockedCompareExchangePointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICStream interface

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to an IStream interface from which to initialize the IWICStream

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the stream is null, or WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the stream is already set or another thread set the stream first.

function.name: IWICStreamImpl_InitializeFromFilename
function.description: This function initializes a stream from a given filename with the specified access mode.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICStream interface

parameters.name: wzFileName
parameters.description: The name of the file to initialize the stream from

parameters.name: dwDesiredAccess
parameters.description: The desired access mode for the stream

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the stream is already set, or E_INVALIDARG if the access mode is invalid

function.name: IWICStreamImpl_InitializeFromMemory
function.description: This function initializes a stream from memory. It checks for valid input, allocates memory for a new StreamOnMemory object, sets its properties, and initializes a critical section. If another thread has already set the stream, it releases the stream and returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICStream interface

parameters.name: pbBuffer
parameters.description: Pointer to a buffer that contains the data to be streamed

parameters.name: cbBufferSize
parameters.description: Size of the buffer

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the buffer is null, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, and WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the stream is already set.

function.name: map_file
function.description: This function maps a file into the memory space of the calling process.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: A handle to the file to be mapped.

parameters.name: map
parameters.description: A pointer to a variable that receives a handle to the file mapping object.

parameters.name: mem
parameters.description: A pointer to a variable that receives a pointer to the file data.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: A pointer to a variable that receives the size of the file.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise it returns an error code.

function.name: stream_initialize_from_filehandle
function.description: This function initializes a stream from a file handle. It maps the file into memory, creates a stream implementation, initializes the stream from memory, and sets up a StreamOnFileHandle object. If another thread has already set the stream, it releases the stream and returns an error. If any step fails, it cleans up and returns the error code.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICStream interface that the function will initialize from a file handle.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Handle to the file that the function will use to initialize the stream.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the function execution. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds, WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the stream is already set or another thread sets the stream first, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, or other error codes if other steps fail.

function.name: IWICStreamImpl_InitializeFromIStreamRegion
function.description: This function initializes a stream from a specified region of an existing stream.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICStream interface

parameters.name: pIStream
parameters.description: Pointer to an IStream interface

parameters.name: ulOffset
parameters.description: Specifies the offset in the stream where the region begins

parameters.name: ulMaxSize
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum size of the stream region

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if successful, error code otherwise

function.name: StreamImpl_Create
function.description: This function creates an instance of IWICStreamImpl, initializes it, and assigns it to the provided stream pointer.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to an IWICStream. The function will assign the created IWICStreamImpl instance to this pointer.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the input argument is invalid, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails.
